decisions.reason: Re-verified 2026-09-21 after production QA found the previous point 44 km from Colón. Digital Realty publishes MEX02 as Carretera Estatal 100, Colon, Querétaro, 76270 and Ascenty publishes km 17.5, Municipio Colón — the address is confirmed first-party and unchanged. PeeringDB facility 11685 carries that same address but publishes a coordinate (20.587478, -100.418636) that sits 3 km from Querétaro city and 44 km from Colón, contradicting its own address fields; the directories repeating it copy PeeringDB rather than corroborate it, so it is rejected. The km 17.5 locale on Carretera Estatal 100 in Colón 76270 is independently placed by OpenStreetMap (Arkansas State University Campus Querétaro, 20.6633861 -100.1087331) and by Google Maps (20.6651639 -100.1101585), 247 m apart. The point adopted is the OpenStreetMap one for that locale. Precision is street, not building: the km marker locates the stretch of road the facility is addressed to, and no source independently locates the Ascenty building itself.
decisions.returnedFormattedAddress: Arkansas State University, Carretera El Colorado - Higuerillas (Carretera Estatal 100), El Gallo, Colón, Querétaro, Mexico
